name: Master of None
description: 30-year-old New York actor Dev takes on such pillars of maturity as the first big job, a serious relationship, and busting sex offenders on the subway.

videos.title: Plan B
videos.overview: A condom mishap and a kid's birthday party prompt Dev to consider the reality of having children.

videos.title: Parents
videos.overview: First-generationers Dev and Brian try to show their appreciation for their immigrant parents at a joint family dinner.

videos.title: Hot Ticket
videos.overview: Dev's plan to score a date with a pretty waitress by inviting her to a concert doesn't have quite the result he wanted.

videos.title: Indians on TV
videos.overview: Dev has a series of eye-opening experiences after he encounters some casual racism in TV auditions.

videos.title: The Other Man
videos.overview: Dev has the chance to hook up with a woman he meets at a party, but the opportunity comes with a few complications.

videos.title: Nashville
videos.overview: For his first official date with Rachel, Dev decides to go big and take her to Nashville for the weekend.

videos.title: Ladies and Gentlemen
videos.overview: Rachel and Denise school Dev and Arnold about the difficulties of being a woman in a world of creepy dudes. Dev is inspired to embrace feminism.

videos.title: Old People
videos.overview: An unexpected death inspires Dev and Rachel to visit Rachel's grandmother, while Arnold contends with a strange inheritance.

videos.title: Mornings
videos.overview: Dev and Rachel discover that living together isn't always going to be a series of happy mornings free from conflict and dirty clothes on the floor.

videos.title: Finale
videos.overview: After attending a wedding and a movie premiere, Dev and Rachel have to face up to all kinds of issues between them.

videos.title: The Thief
videos.overview: While studying pasta making in Italy, Dev makes a serendipitous connection on his birthday, only to have his plans upended by a thief.

videos.title: Le Nozze
videos.overview: Arnold stops by on his way to a wedding to explore Modena with his Little Bud. But he hasn't told Dev the whole truth about his trip.

videos.title: Religion
videos.overview: Back in New York, a visit from observant Muslim relatives puts Dev in a tricky position. He introduces his cousin to a forbidden pleasure: pork.

videos.title: First Date
videos.overview: Sucked into a popular dating app, Dev winds up on a string of awkward, fun and disorienting dates with very different women.

videos.title: The Dinner Party
videos.overview: After welcoming the Jabbawockeez to his show, Dev struggles to find the right date to take to a dinner party thrown by his celebrity chef boss.

videos.title: New York, I Love You
videos.overview: As Dev and friends head to a theater to see the hit movie "Death Castle," the lives of several ordinary New Yorkers intersect in subtle ways.

videos.title: Door #3
videos.overview: A sweet job offer forces Dev to take stock of his priorities. Brian helps his dad with a romantic dilemma. A cupcake competition judge gets cold feet.

videos.title: Thanksgiving
videos.overview: Over a series of Thanksgivings from the '90s to the present, Denise settles into her sexuality and faces the challenge of coming out to her family.

videos.title: Amarsi Un Po
videos.overview: When Francesca returns to New York for a month, Dev plays tour guide and finds himself caught in a whirlwind of confusing emotions.

videos.title: Buona Notte
videos.overview: Just as Dev's personal life reaches a tipping point, disturbing revelations throw his professional life into turmoil, too.

videos.title: Moments in Love, Chapter 1
videos.overview: Now a bestselling author, Denise leads a quiet life with her wife, Alicia, in upstate New York. But dinner with another couple leads to bigger questions.

videos.title: Moments in Love, Chapter 2
videos.overview: As the mood in the house grows more strained, Alicia leaves town for an antique fair.

videos.title: Moments in Love, Chapter 3
videos.overview: Facing a wave of major changes in her life, Denise wrestles with feelings of guilt and failure.

videos.title: Moments in Love, Chapter 4
videos.overview: Alicia turns to a fertility clinic for help and soon finds herself on a physical, financial and emotional odyssey.

videos.title: Moments in Love, Chapter 5
videos.overview: A trip upstate leads to reflections on the past and present.

awards: Won 3 Primetime Emmys. 21 wins & 76 nominations total
